Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. items.t: New Westminster real estate market stats

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in West End?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 16 houses and 2 condos and townhomes listed in West End. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: How many homes sold in West End from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 6 houses and 0 condos and townhomes sold in West End over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in June with 3 sold.

faq.q: How big is West End compared with the rest of New Westminster?
faq.a: In September 2026, West End held 9.8% of the 164 detached houses listed in New Westminster and 0.5% of the 444 condos and townhomes listed in New Westminster.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in West End?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 88.9% of the 18 homes listed in West End and condos and townhomes made up 11.1%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in West End than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 18 to 16 (−11.1%) and condos and townhomes rose from 1 to 2 (+100.0%) between June 2026 and September 2026.
